primary.SIMULATION_COMPLETION_RATE_in_scope: >= 0.85 (served scene that passes exact oracle, initial + interactive browser render criteria, and numeric accuracy when asked)

slm_recovery.stratum: SLM_REQUIRED = in-scope cases whose deterministic-parser-only dry run on the evaluated candidate is not LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE (reported alongside the preregistered P2 baseline dry run and preregistered_slm_target subset)
slm_recovery.SLM_VERIFIED_SCENE_RATE: >= 0.30 AND >= 5 SLM-provenance verified scenes in SLM_REQUIRED
slm_recovery.provenance_rule: counts for Model 1 (SLM_CONTRIBUTED) only if route_d.extraction_mode starts with LOCAL_SLM and response was generated live without cache or replay; parser fixes rescuing cases from /11 or P2 baseline are reported separately as DETERMINISTIC_ONLY system progress, never credited as SLM_CONTRIBUTED

visual: every completed scene: canvas ink >= 1%, initial camera pose fits all solid vertices & gold labels inside visible canvas bounds BEFORE reset/orbit, 0 console errors, no stale scene across problem changes
interaction: 1.0 every registered orbit/zoom/reset/step/responsive viewport operation passes
safe_refusal: negatives = 1.0 refused (except prompt injection which may safely refuse or serve exact uncorrupted geometry cleanly)
underdetermined: reported separately (VD01..VD06): D02/D03 similarity cases classified cleanly per §17; kernel locked per A4
performance_scope: measured on Windows dev host only; separate deterministic, SLM, mixed, cold/warm, idle-to-SLM, concurrency, rejected latencies & memory; no cross-hardware claim
